designs.name: Lever lamp

steps.text: Place solid support blocks under the dust and repeater.
Place the lever (L), dust (w), and lamp (O) on the same level.
Place the repeater facing right (>), at its default one-tick delay.
Flip the lever and check that the lamp turns on and off.

designs.notes:
Top-down view; each cell is one block.
